VENDORED SOMA-GUIDE ENGINE — provenance and drift record
=========================================================

Why these files are here
------------------------
Until 2026-08-11 the Legends site loaded the Ask Bill widget engine from
https://soma-guide.netlify.app — a third-party host with a MANUAL (non-git)
deploy. On 2026-08-11 that host was returning 404 for the entire site:

    curl -sI https://soma-guide.netlify.app/soma-guide.js  -> HTTP/2 404
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://soma-guide.netlify.app/  -> 404

Production was still serving those references, so window.somaGuide was
undefined for every member, the in-page #ask-bill-section button did nothing,
and the stylesheet 404'd. Nothing in the estate noticed. Legends is priority #1;
its member-facing guide must not depend on a hand-deployed third-party host.

These assets are therefore VENDORED and served same-origin from
/vendor/soma-guide/, so Ask Bill ships and rolls back with this repo.

------
Repo:          ~/Projects/soma-platform

Working tree:  CLEAN at time of copy (git status --porcelain packages/soma-guide/ was empty)
Engine version: SOMA_GUIDE_VERSION = '2026-0727a'
Copied:        2026-08-11 (UTC) by the vendoring pass

These files are a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy of the source. Do not hand-edit them.
All Legends-specific behaviour lives in:
    js/legends-guide-config.js          (persona, walkthroughs, endpoints)
    js/legends-knowledge.js             (site knowledge pack)
    js/legends-ask-bill-resilience.js   (degradation layer)

How to detect drift
-------------------
    shasum -a 256 vendor/soma-guide/*.js vendor/soma-guide/*.css
    shasum -a 256 ~/Projects/soma-platform/packages/soma-guide/soma-guide.{js,css}

`npm run verify:deploy` compares the LIVE same-origin assets against these
vendored files, and `npm run test:dependency-failures` asserts the vendored
engine still emits the sentinel string the resilience layer hooks. If soma-platform
moves ahead, re-copy the three files and update the SHA + checksums above.

How to refresh
--------------
    SRC=~/Projects/soma-platform/packages/soma-guide
    cp $SRC/soma-guide.js $SRC/soma-guide.css $SRC/soma-guide-shim.js vendor/soma-guide/
    npm run test:dependency-failures     # must stay green
    # then update the SHA, date and checksums in this file

Do NOT re-point the HTML back at soma-guide.netlify.app.
